verdict.rationale: Google Cloud's own Infrastructure Manager docs say you can define your Google Cloud infrastructure declaratively with Terraform and preview changes before applying them. That implies first-party Terraform support for Google Cloud resources, but the evidence never names the provider itself or describes its maintenance or release history. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of an official vendor-maintained Terraform/OpenTofu provider, evidence of active release cadence, documented coverage of core services, OpenTofu compatibility, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, the official Terraform/OpenTofu provider is real — vendor-maintained, actively released, covering the core services I run

citations.quote: Define your infrastructure declaratively using Terraform.
Create preview deployments to see how changes affect your infrastructure before applying them.
